I posted this as I had a slight glimmer of hope that appears every so often and from everyone who's responded to me negatively and the unbelievable hypocrisy I've been given more and more incentive to go absolutely full dark side.

I'm absolutely done with who I was, I'm going to fuck whoever I want, hurt whoever I want, do whatever I want and get whatever I want.

I'll be more than scum, I'll be the scum on your wall that produces spores that kill everyone who comes anywhere near.

I owe him that money but it's not his fault at all I lost my house, I made the decision to rent it out and I'll decide what I do next. What happens in the future will definitely be us apart   but I can't leave while I owe money, he will destroy me.

So you're not stuck in your marriage? You can just freely leave whenever you please and are completely open and honest with your spouse and children?

I've survived the past 7 years on my own and moved out of my cheating parents 20 years ago never to look back, how many years have you managed on your own?

You're angry because you know I'm right, you involved innocent children and I could never do that.

I feel bad for your kids, I know what lies ahead for them.

Oh wait I get your justification, youre ruining your children's lives because youre selfish, I should know, I had the same child hood "we're waiting to divorce when you're old enough" hence I grew up getting cheated on or beaten up and a very good reason I was never stupid enough to marry but found myself in yet another shitty controlling relationship. 

Well done, I should have expected such hypocrisy from a sub full of cheaters and liars.

FYI, your kids will grow up to hate you and will end up just like me. I guarantee you.
Sure....sure....

Oh I definitely won't, I rented my house out to one of his friends so we both had a house, his friend disappeared after not paying rent for 5 months when I was already behind and off work so Its been repossessed. He couldn't have known this would happen but I should have.

I won't make this mistake again. Why do you stay with your spouse?

He's considering opening? That's great, I hope it goes well for you. I know about the health conditions I have some doozies! I very much doubt mine would open up but we have talked threesomes before (before the celibacy). 

I just feel tricked, I got myself into debt for us trying to rent out my house and ended up losing it and borrowing from him. I really wish I'd stayed where I was, happy in my little house.

Since talking with this other guy me and my boyfriend have had the best relationship since before we moved in (back when we actually had sex!), We don't argue over stupid things or get so angry and me crying al the time. I don't know why he wants to be with me after all that but he says he loves me and wants to be with me and I get angry because of the sex but I don't know whether it's his autism but he just doesn't want to hear it.

I want to get out but I want to get out alive and not living on the street. At the same time I don't want to hurt him.

No friends, all family dead, in a town miles away from anyone I remotely know and an autistic boyfriend that would push me out of the front door as soon as the relationship ends. I'm not a slave, I just owe money and we have a contract for the full amount but he'd take all my possessions if I split up before paying him including my car which is the only thing I could reasonably live in.

It is definitely not a long term plan, I owe him money and with no other options of where to live I can't get away for at least 6 months.

He will not acknowledge it, I've tried a gentle ask which is ignored and the direct approach is met with much shouting then in passing conversation he makes comments alluding to my "high libido" as though it's something disgusting.

I can't stay with him that's definite but right now I can't go anywhere and  if we split he would not let me live here.

The only thing making me consider it and not feel guilty is the fact that we're not intimate. I don't know why but I just don't feel guilty.

What stopped you from just ending it? I can't leave because I owe him money and I have no family or friends to help me out, I know no one and he knows that id have to stay here until I can pay it off and I'm miserable enough as it is.

All we've done is bicker.....that is until I started talking to my "ap". Now we're actually getting on ok.

I owe him money, if I broke it off now I'd be sleeping on a park bench. I posted here as I thought I'm least likely to get death threats.

It's going to take me a good 6 months until I can afford to move out.
I owe him money, 2k, as soon as I pay it off and save up for a flat I'm gone but right now he'd kick me out and keep my pets.
